review_scope: Independent source/API review; not an inference or generalization accuracy claim.
checks: Inference interfaces accept support RGB+support box and query RGB; no query annotation or family identity.
All six arms share CNN foreground proposals and original own-trained checkpoint.
Native-patch scoring does not consult connected-feature/covariance descriptors, although the joint evaluation computes them for moment controls.
Lowres control preserves native outline alignment and patch positions/count/weights; only fine RGB evidence is degraded.
RMS floor handles near-constant patches; blank/empty proposals return finite rejection scores.
Centroid/size/missing-count control keeps outline gate and assignments while removing covariance cost.
Original CNN descriptor recipe remains intact; no optimizers are created.
Old-development evaluation filters only declared old DEV rows; fresh evaluation requires frozen source, admission and data-audit hash bindings.
Ground-truth boxes and labels are read for metrics only after prediction.
limitations: New matching logic is analytic, not newly learned CNN weights.
High-contrast separated-object and internal-gradient priors restrict scope.
Native sampling still uses bilinear interpolation.
A direct baseline improvement combines alignment and matching changes; matched lowres ablation is the narrower information-preservation comparison.
tests: 6 production gradient-detail unit tests passed; separate5gallery tests passed.
